challenges.title: Debounced Search Bar
challenges.prompt: Build a search input that queries an API as the user types. Debounce input by 300ms, cancel in-flight requests when a newer query starts, show loading and empty states, and handle errors gracefully.
challenges.evalRubric: Debounce implemented without leaking timers; AbortController or ignore-stale-response guard; race condition between responses handled; keyboard accessible; no unnecessary re-renders; cleanup on unmount.

challenges.title: Infinite Scroll List
challenges.prompt: Render a list that loads the next page when the user nears the bottom. Use IntersectionObserver, avoid duplicate fetches, preserve scroll position, and support a 'jump to top' control.
challenges.evalRubric: IntersectionObserver used correctly with cleanup; guard against concurrent fetches; page state managed immutably; list virtualization considered or justified as unnecessary; accessible live region for 'loading more'.

challenges.title: Kanban Board (drag & drop)
challenges.prompt: Build a 3-column kanban board where cards can be dragged between columns and reordered within a column. State must be the single source of truth; drag should be keyboard-accessible too.
challenges.evalRubric: Immutable state transitions for move/reorder; drop targets computed correctly; keyboard alternative present (aria-grabbed / move buttons); no index bugs on cross-column move; re-render scope contained.

challenges.title: Typeahead / Autocomplete
challenges.prompt: Build an accessible combobox: arrow keys navigate suggestions, Enter selects, Escape closes, aria-activedescendant tracks the highlighted option, and the list is filtered from a large dataset.
challenges.evalRubric: Correct ARIA roles/attrs (combobox, listbox, option, aria-expanded, aria-activedescendant); focus stays on input; no scroll trap; filtering is O(n) not re-sorting each keystroke.

challenges.title: Sortable + Filterable Data Table
challenges.prompt: Build a table with column sorting (asc/desc/none), a text filter, and pagination. URL should reflect sort/filter/page so the view is shareable.
requirements: state synced to URL search params
scroll container, no horizontal body overflow
challenges.evalRubric: Derived rows (sort+filter+page) computed without mutating source; URL is the state store; stable sort; empty-filter-result state; header cells are buttons with aria-sort.

challenges.title: Accessible Modal / Dialog
challenges.prompt: Build a modal dialog: focus is trapped inside, Escape closes, focus returns to the trigger on close, background is inert, and the dialog is announced to screen readers.
challenges.evalRubric: Focus trap handles Tab and Shift+Tab wrap; initial focus sensible; focus restored to opener; no scroll bleed; body/background marked inert or aria-hidden; unmount cleanup.

challenges.title: Multi-step Form with Validation
challenges.prompt: Build a 3-step form with per-field validation, inline errors tied to inputs, a progress indicator, back/next navigation that preserves data, and a final review step.
challenges.evalRubric: Validation schema-driven; errors associated with inputs; focus moves to first error on failed next; no data loss navigating back; controlled inputs, immutable updates.

challenges.title: Toast Notification System
challenges.prompt: Build a toast system with a provider + imperative API (toast.success(...)), auto-dismiss with pause-on-hover, a max visible count with a queue, and an aria-live region.
challenges.evalRubric: Timers cleaned up; pause/resume math correct; queue drains in order; live region not re-created per toast; animations compositor-friendly; id collisions avoided.
